test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

She was driving the car when the accident occurred.

options.text: The car is being driven by her when the accident occurred.
The car had been driven by her when the accident occurred.
The car was being driven by her when the accident occurred.
She had driven the car when the accident occurred.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 

• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 

• In the active voice, the sentence is: "She was driving the car when the accident occurred." 

• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the car" at the beginning. 

• Change the active verb form "was driving" to "was being driven" (past continuous passive). 

• Retain the time phrase "when the accident occurred" as it is essential to the sentence meaning. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The car was being driven by her when the accident occurred."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 

• **Option 1: **"The car is being driven by her when the accident occurred." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive). 

• **Option 2: **"The car had been driven by her when the accident occurred." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive). 

• **Option 4: **"She had driven the car when the accident occurred." – Incorrect voice (active voice).
